items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, requeue, or forecast. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate provider row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, and budget exposure are not calculable: infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, other operating costs, experiment-level costs, incremental outcomes, and approved financial limits are absent. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned cost ledger matched to site-attributed commission, experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes, and owner-approved monthly limits. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded security evidence work only; reject vanity metrics and unsupported revenue claims.

CFO rejects any claim that impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, or deployed changes establish financial return. Preserve unknown contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, and operating health until the minimum measurement is available.
